content: Autosave race conditions: an older debounced save resolving after newer edits can overwrite/reset the buffer. Debouncing alone doesn't guarantee ordering; need FIFO write queue per file. Atomic write pattern: write to temp file in same directory, fsync, then rename (POSIX rename is atomic; Windows needs ReplaceFile/MoveFileEx with MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING). Atomic rename does not coordinate multiple writers -- need in-process lock/mutex if multiple save triggers can overlap.
